scripts.typecheck: pnpm -r run typecheck && pnpm run typecheck:tooling && cargo check --workspace
scripts.test:smoke: node scripts/ensure-wasm.mjs && tsx scripts/withGateLock.ts pnpm exec playwright test
scripts.test:pwa: tsx scripts/withGateLock.ts pnpm exec playwright test --config playwright.pwa.config.ts
scripts.generate:bindings: cargo test -p atlantis-hud-core --lib export_bindings_ && tsx scripts/checkGenerated.ts --write-barrel
scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run check:generated && pnpm run test:smoke && pnpm run build:web && pnpm run test:pwa && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
